wrong_globalBox.rejection: Cross-tile input globalBox differs from the current pinned manifest.

retagged_target_pixel_tamper.rejection: Edit target does not exactly equal the current verified cross-tile crop; ancestor reuse is not supported.

generation_reference_mismatch.rejection: Generation reference order/list differs from cross-tile input.

receipt_reference_mismatch.rejection: Builtin receipt did not submit the exact ordered cross-tile references.

receipt_prompt_mismatch.rejection: Builtin receipt prompt text differs from saved prompt.

crop_ancestry_cycle.rejection: Cyclic or excessive repair provenance chain.

projection_offset_tamper.rejection: Projection changed the exact source/tile intersection.

retagged_operation_offset_tamper.rejection: Cross-tile selected counts or source offsets changed.

retagged_unselected_output_pixel_change.rejection: Cross-tile output changed a mask-zero pixel or copied a wrong native coordinate.

overwrite_existing_output_version.rejection: Output version already exists; never overwrite.

projection_out_of_bounds.rejection: Projection boxes leave source or tile bounds.
